source: KNMI CESAR Cabauw lc1 v1.0, paired surface meteo and radiation, 10-minute UTC intervals
local_clock: fixed CET UTC+01:00, no daylight-saving change
leap_year_rule: The 2020 365-day local campaign includes 29 February and excludes local 31 December; the exclusion is calendrical, not outcome-based.
initial_observation_halo: At t=0 the controller may read the immediately preceding completed 10-minute interval. This interval can belong to the preceding year's campaign; exclude such bootstrap intervals from weather-generator fitting/holdout similarity statistics and disclose the overlap.
forbidden_uses: Selecting source years or windows by simulated crop performance
Tuning simulator, controller, generator, exclusions or baselines on the 2020 diagnostic result and still calling it untouched
Treating 365 days, compartments or within-year segments as independent weather years
Presenting an exact public weather replay as a private confirmatory site
confirmatory_rule: After development freezes the generator and exclusions, create private non-replay weather/site paths with unrevealed seeds and a source-path similarity audit; this partition alone does not define the formal confirmatory matrix.
